PROGRESS was read and independently audited, but it is not accepted as DELIVERY. The delivered source added normalizeR2ObjectKey() and withinR2ObjectLimits() without wiring either helper into the existing upload, generated-output, preview or failed-upload reconciliation paths. The changed test file adds key/size/config/provider-probe coverage, but does not prove preview authorization, unknown/failed reconciliation, idempotent retry or retention/deletion behavior over the existing contracts. The current source still has media-upload.ts calling storeGeneratedAsset/local AXIOM_MEDIA_ROOT, asset-preview.ts validating its own local storageKey path, and no callsite for the new R2 object helpers.

This is the single permitted correction for this lane. Work only in /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-r2-storage-current-r4 against exact SOURCE_REF a462ea0e74cec267ba61678909183ef4b652b51d. Keep the existing asset/media/media-operation/gallery contracts; do not invent a parallel schema or unapproved provider path. Add the minimum real source wiring needed so upload/generated/preview and uncertain retry paths enforce the same bounded tenant/model object identity, content/type/size limits, authorization and explicit unknown/failure state. Add behavior tests that exercise preview authorization, failed/unknown reconciliation, idempotent retry and any retention/deletion semantics actually supported by the current contracts. If a criterion cannot be implemented without an unapproved schema/provider decision, return terminal BLOCKED naming that exact contract gap instead of claiming DELIVERY. Return one corrected evidence-bearing PROGRESS and then one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED with changed paths, per-file SHA-256 values, exact commands and real exit codes. No credentials, provider calls, bucket mutation, database, migration, deployment, runtime, permission, network, commit or push action. Do not repeat the previous helper-only precheck. sincerely, Codex
